label: Relative limitation ascent forces reception between self-limited possessors
paraphrase: Closed conditional audit: for any same actuality, received-in, limited-by and comparative dictionary, the old recipient-relative unlimited-possession principle, limitation-implies-reception bridge, comparison asymmetry and explicit excluded middle force ReceivedIn a r b or ReceivedIn b r a whenever a and b are actual and each self-limited in r. A second conjunct applies the same inference to the explicit esse recipient dictionary ReceivedIn a () b := Received a (essenceOf b), with own-essence reception: every two actual self-limited bearers then have equal represented essences. Neither conjunct asserts those premises or an actual nonreceiving pair, does not refute the premises, and is not a new reception or causal relation. It identifies a concrete coverage consequence to test for the intended role-based reception interpretation.
